craft_notes: Sthāyin: the light-behavior — shines-and-touches. Sanskrit-first: yathāiva…tathā kept the simile-frame; āmṛśaty kept touches (contact, not merely manifests). Rows: 1 ('so the discrimination' closes — vivecana follows), 3 (shines/touches pair), 12 (frame settles). Close: 'so the discrimination.' Rejected: 'contacts' — killed: āmṛśati is touches (the light's own move); expanding the frame — killed: three clauses are the whole verse.

lines: as it shines it touches also —
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃvitprakāśaparamārthatayā yathaiva bhāty āmṛśaty api tatheti vivecayantaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How does the light behave? → The paramārtha-light both manifests and contacts: the vivecana follows the double move.
c1_essence: Light by consciousness-nature shines and touches together — the discrimination follows.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of authority established (wonder settling into doctrinal calm)
